title: Character Counter Input
prompt:
You are a web developer. Complete the following task.

TASK: Build a React functional component called `CharCounter` that renders a textarea and a character count display below it. The character count should update in real-time as the user types. Maximum 200 characters. When the user exceeds 200 characters, show the count in red by adding a class `over-limit`. Display format: "X / 200".

CONSTRAINTS:
- Functional component with `useState`
- Default export
- Max 200 characters
- Display format: "{count} / 200"
- Add class `over-limit` when count > 200

IMPORTANT:
- Return ONLY the code. No explanations.
- Output a single complete file.
- Do not use markdown code blocks.
